source: Fixed inputs requested by the owner; arithmetic in this standalone generator, no imports from application calculation modules.

definitions.quantile: R7: h=(n-1)p; linear interpolation between sorted[floor(h)] and sorted[ceil(h)]
definitions.iqr: Q3-Q1; candidate outside Q1-1.5IQR or Q3+1.5IQR; no automatic deletion
definitions.withinXmR: mean adjacent moving range / d2; d2=1.128, d3=.8525
definitions.oos: outside strict specification limits / all valid numeric measurements; limits themselves are in specification
definitions.time: Wall-clock ISO date-times with one consistent basis. Minute=(end-start)/60000. No timezone inference.
definitions.parallel: Sum of durations differs from union of intervals and firstStart-to-lastEnd elapsed.

tolerances.reason: Fixed small inputs and double-precision arithmetic; UI formatting is compared separately at its shown precision.
tolerances.ocr: No numerical tolerance for OCR transcription: compare source text exactly and correct before confirming.
